query: How can I cancel a Short-Term Visit Pass?
reference_answer: The Short-Term Visit Pass (STVP) will automatically expire after the last day of validity or when the traveller departs Singapore. There is no need to cancel the STVP if a traveller wishes to depart Singapore before the expiry.
